# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve FR2 Reborn. You do not need to know every GitHub feature to take part.

## Report a problem

Open Issues and choose Report a bug. Share the game version, your device, what happened, and what you expected. A screenshot can help. Never include passwords or private account information.

## Suggest an improvement

Open Issues and choose Suggest an improvement. Explain the idea and how it would help players.

## Ask for help

Open Issues and choose Ask a question. Explain what you are trying to do and what you have already tried.

## Send a code change

1. Create a fork of the repository with the Fork button.
2. Make your change in your fork.
3. Open your fork and choose Contribute, then Open pull request.
4. Explain what changed and why it helps.
5. Add screenshots when a screen changes.

Build and check the game in Solar2D. GitHub does not build this project. If you cannot run Solar2D, explain that in the pull request.

Please keep each change focused. Do not add game saves, signing keys, passwords, private account details, or built app files to a pull request.
